description: Search JoinTheDeal: group deals sold by JoinTheDeal (with goal, joined count, deal window, payment terms), requested deals (people gathering, no price yet) and Deal Finder offers from other sellers (comparison reference only). Results come in that order. Filter by keywords, category, event, seller and price range. If nothing of JoinTheDeal matches (jtd_match=false) the response carries request_url for the user to start a request.

category.description: Category or subcategory name or part of it (see list_categories), e.g. "Korean grocery", "Fishing", "Robot vacuums".

deal_type.description: group_deal = sold by JoinTheDeal; requested = people gathering for an item (no price yet); deal_finder = sold by another seller (comparison only).

event.description: Event tag, e.g. "black-friday-2026" (deals the seller itself labels Black Friday / Cyber Monday). See list_categories events.

min_price.description: Minimum price in USD. Offers without a single dollar price (e.g. "Up to $800 off") are left out when a price filter is used.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "rice cooker", "air purifier", "mattress queen". All words must match.

seller.description: Seller name or part of it, e.g. "CUCKOO", "LG", "H Mart".

name: search_deals
title: Search deals
